description: This file declares functions and includes related to HTTP Digest Authentication in the curl project. It contains function prototypes for processing digest headers, creating digest headers, and cleaning up digest authentication data.

methods.name: Curl_input_digest
methods.description: Processes the digest header input for HTTP authentication, updating the Curl_easy data structure.

methods.name: Curl_output_digest
methods.description: Creates the digest authorization header for HTTP requests based on the provided request data.

methods.name: Curl_http_auth_cleanup_digest
methods.description: Cleans up any allocated resources related to digest authentication in the Curl_easy data structure.
